QuestInfo.name: A Strange Letter
QuestInfo.0: Someone sent you a letter. What's this all about?
QuestInfo.1: The author of the letter claims to know who the new Commander is. This is almost certainly a trap, but it's also an opportunity. Head to the place mentioned in the letter and poke around.(Exit on the west side of #b#m240000000##k and head to the hidden portal in #b#m240010000##k.)
QuestInfo.2: This is getting more and more mystifying. The Commander is somehow connected to you? What could that Demon have meant?
